_doctrine: Patterns FIRING right now (today's factor bins match a mined pattern). firing[] = PROVEN patterns (>=5 separate historical turns) — real confirmation signals to weigh. watching[] = THIN patterns (3-4 turns) that also match today but haven't earned a live voice yet. Observational; never auto-gates.
threshold_drift_note: the mine ran on 2026-07-11 against 4056 history rows; the matcher now recomputes bins from 4089. Where a factor appears below, its quartile cutpoints have MOVED under a label that has not - a fire or a miss on that factor may be coordinate drift, not market change.
spurious_rule_note: the mined file's _doctrine describes spurious_risk as support < 8, but pattern_miner.py sets it on distinct < 5. Seven of eight rules are muted by this flag, so which definition is intended materially changes how much of the library can ever speak.

wrong_bins: lumber is mid high, needs mid low

why_quiet: genuinely quiet: every mined factor read cleanly and no pattern's bins match today. This is the engine working.
